name: The Lost Laugh
description: Comic relief.|Comedian Jestin has gone flat after too many bad shifts. Find the static feather that can snap his morale back.

text: Woe is me! My laugh, my joy, it's all gone!
Old camp rumor says a static tickling feather can bring it back.
Would you be a dear and find it for me?
completedText: Search for the static tickling feather.

text: Bawk! Oh, the tickling feather? I might have it...
But I need some worms first. Bawk!
completedText: Fetch some worms for the old chicken.

text: Ha-HA! That's the stuff! I feel giggly already!
Here's a potion to share the giggles and some stage boots.

popup.title: Quest completed!
popup.text: @green@Jestin's laugh is back, all thanks to you! Enjoy spreading giggles with the @crimson@giggly-potion@green@ and strut in your new stage boots.
